text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Tenno Sho (Autumn) approaching.
Just as I finished work and was getting ready to head home—
(Knock knock knock!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Trainer-kun.
How're ya doin'~?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Trainer-chan.
How're ya doin'~?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, can't you tell from what I'm wearing?
I was thinking of doing some training now~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The Senior Class is packed with powerhouses, and talented underclassmen are making their mark too...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "I realized I couldn't just sit around, so big sis here is giving it her all!♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, can you tell?
I'm itching to run with all sorts of girls!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Though it's true I've gotten pretty desperate. I need to give it my all so we can have a fun race!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, if you're free,
I was kind of hoping you'd hang out with me for a bit~...
choice_data_list: Of course I'll come with you!
Of course I'll come with you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Let's sweat out our youth together!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"The heat dies down quite a bit at night,
so it's perfect for training~."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, oh?
Looks like someone beat us here...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whew... *pant*... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Yaaay! I cut down my time again~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do one more lap focusing on pace!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hang in theeeeere... rumba~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan, out here all by yourself until this hour...
choice_data_list: You look like you're having fun running.
You look like you're having fun running.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I can clearly feel just how much
you're dying to run.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't we head somewhere else?
We wouldn't want to get in their way.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I believe the day will come when we run together, so hang in there, Spe-chan...!
A few days later, a press conference was scheduled for the Umamusume running in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

Actually, they handed out the list of race participants
just a moment ago, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Geez, why won't you show me
the race card?
choice_data_list: I thought it'd give us something more to look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmph, so you're gonna be mean like that, huh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, the press conference is about to start anyway,
so we'll find out soon enough~.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
We will now begin the press conference with the
Umamusume running in the Autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Would our first contestant please come up to the stage?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes!
Being first makes me wicked nervous~...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm Special Week!
It's nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I heard you've been putting in grueling training
in preparation for this race.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but I was looking forward to it so much
that it was no trouble at all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I'm in better shape,
and I feel more confident than ever before!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
You just mentioned 'looking forward' to it—
do you have any special feelings going into this race?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm going to run with my whole heart,
promising to put on a race full of fun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan... Watching Grass Wonder-san's
Yasuda Kinen was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Seeing you run with all your might got me excited too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“Still, as fun as it was, I was just as envious.
I thought to myself, 'The person running must be having even more fun~.'”

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: You want to join in on the fun race too?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I thought I didn't have what it takes,
and couldn't possibly make races fun, but……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I just couldn't hold back anymore—I wanted to chase
after the back of the one I look up to, so I gave it my all!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
At the autumn Tenno Sho, I will overtake that idolized
back that taught me the joy of running.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I will defeat Maruzensky-san...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I see~ That's why you kept the race entries
a secret, huh...
As she said that, Maruzensky kept her eyes locked onto Special Week up on the stage.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what are you doing to me?
I'm looking forward to it so much I can't stop grinning.
choice_data_list: This is definitely going to be an exciting race.
This is definitely going to be a fun race, huh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes... I gladly accept your challenge, Spe-chan...!
And so, the showdown with Special Week at the Tenno Sho (Autumn) was set!
